headline: Uzbekistan Commissions $500 Million Thermal Power Plant in Jizzakh
summary: Uzbekistan commissioned a $500 million combined-cycle thermal power plant in the Jizzakh region, adding 4.4 billion kWh in annual electricity capacity while saving 500 million cubic meters of natural gas annually.
why: Uzbekistan is aggressively expanding its power grid and modernizing industrial utility infrastructure across Central Asia.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: The new power plant increases grid capacity and cuts national natural gas consumption.
